messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty - P1: auth-proxy anomaly detected in prod at 02:14 UTC. 401 spike from ~12 IPs. Initiating incident thread.
maria: oncall here, looking. which region?
raj: seeing spike in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. repeated token reuse patterns, some request headers include s3-upload hints.
alice: dumping a couple of redacted log lines:
```
ts=2026-02-14T02:13:59Z level=warn svc=auth-proxy status=401 method=POST path=/v1/generate src=3.84.12.22 token_partial="eyJhbGci..."
ts=2026-02-14T02:14:03Z level=warn svc=auth-proxy status=401 method=POST path=/v1/embeddings src=18.204.33.5 token_partial="eyJ0eXAi..."
```
maria: looks like tokens in logs, probably debug-logger left enabled on a subset of edge pods.
raj: agree. initial scope: edge auth-proxy podset 'edge-12' in those regions. I can rotate affected service-account tokens and revoke cached sessions. Need an ETA for rotation.
lee: tagging in for night shift. I can do rotation and kube rollout. recommend: 1) revoke affected SA keys, 2) deploy config to stop debug logging, 3) scrub logs from ephemeral buckets.
carla: legal: possible customer token exposure. please preserve evidence, limit distribution, don't paste raw tokens. notify privacy team after we confirm scope.
tim: CS: can we get list of customers impacted? we need to prepare comms if tokens were leaked.
alice: running script to list pods with DEBUG logging: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=edge-proxy -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}' | xargs -n1 -I{} kubectl -n prod logs {} | grep -E "token|Authorization"`
maria: action plan: maria -> isolate edge-12 (cordon + scale down), lee -> rotate SA keys (KMS+IAM), raj -> block offending IPs at WAF, alice -> scrub logs and kick off S3 lifecycle delete for the last 24h dump. tim -> prepare customer list and draft hold message.
lee: ack, starting rotation now. I'll push canary to us-east-1, then eu-west-1. will update in thread. ETA 20m.
raj: WAF rule deployed to block the 12 IPs and similar ASN ranges. monitoring for reduction.
alice: started scrub job for s3://redwood-logs/prod/edge-proxy/2026-02-14/, deleting objects containing "Authorization" (keeping a copy in internal EDL for forensics).
maria: handing off to lee for live mitigation. I'm stepping out to coordinate with infra. Lee please take ownership and close when fixed.
lee: taking ownership. status: rotation in progress, WAF active, scrub started. no evidence yet of customer-facing outages. will escalate to legal if we find full tokens or PII.
carla: thanks. preserve chain of custody for scrub logs. legal will join post-mitigation audit.
tim: CS on standby; if we confirm customer token exposure, we'll follow breach playbook. keep me posted.
lee: final note: after rotation I'll rotate NLB session cookies and invalidate cache. expected full containment in ~45m. updating last_message_ts when resolved.
